note: P is four two-colour-plus-ratio-slider mixers (circle, command prompt, shaded box, side-by-side model compare) with the same channel-mean vs linear-light toggle; R is four near-identical blank black brush canvases with RGB sliders, swatches and Paint/Light/Average modes, differing mostly in panel layout; Q ranges over a three-source field with draggable probes, a pigment bowl with kept mixes, a pot-and-grid painter and an R/G/B ink-drop field.
